dedupe_keys.name: aerodrome reports and forecasts for luxembourg airport ellx

description: Aerodrome Reports and Forecasts for Luxembourg-Airport (ELLX) is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MeteoLux. METAR: Meteorological Aerodrome Report issued every 30 minutes at HH+20 and HH+50 TAF: Terminal Aerodrome Forecast issued every 6 hours - aeronautical forecast valid for the next 30 hours LAF: Local Aerodrome Forecast issued every 3 hours - aeronautical forecast valid for the next 9 hours. Coverage: MeteoLux. The publisher named on the listing is MeteoLux. Its keywords include meteorology, mobility, climat, transport, waether. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
